metadata.title: Docetaxel Monotherapy 75 mg/m² – 21 day cycle
metadata.indication: Docetaxel monotherapy for advanced breast cancer and first-line high-risk non-metastatic or metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification or non-standard continuation should be discussed with a Consultant.

febrile_neutropenia_or_prolonged_grade4.label: Febrile neutropenia or ANC <0.5 ×10⁹/L for >1 week

options.label: Bilirubin normal and enzymes below adjustment bands
Bilirubin normal; AST/ALT >1.5–5 ×ULN with ALP >2.5–5 ×ULN — 75% dose
Bilirubin 1–1.5 ×ULN and/or AST/ALT >5–10 ×ULN with ALP <6 ×ULN — 50% dose
Bilirubin >1.5 ×ULN or AST/ALT >10 ×ULN or ALP >6 ×ULN — not recommended

neuropathy_grade.label: Peripheral neuropathy grade

options.label: Grade 0 — No neuropathy
options.description: No peripheral sensory or motor neuropathy.

options.label: Grade 1 — Grade 1
options.description: Asymptomatic; clinical or diagnostic observations only. CTCAE v5.0 grades symptomatic paraesthesia separately when that is the more accurate term.

options.label: Grade 2 — Grade 2
options.description: Moderate symptoms that limit instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3 — Grade 3
options.description: Severe symptoms that limit self-care activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 4 — Grade 4
options.description: Life-threatening neurological consequences; urgent intervention required.

neuropathy_grade.assessment_guidance: Identify the exact adverse event, assess symptoms and functional impact, and apply the toxicity-specific CTCAE v5.0 definition. Do not grade solely from a generic severity impression.

skin_toxicity_grade.label: Skin toxicity grade

options.label: Grade 0 — No rash
options.description: No rash. Use the most specific CTCAE skin term when a rash is present.

options.label: Grade 1 — Grade 1
options.description: For maculopapular rash: under 10% body-surface area, with or without symptoms such as itch, burning or tightness.

options.label: Grade 2 — Grade 2
options.description: For maculopapular rash: 10–30% body-surface area, or rash limiting instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3 — Grade 3
options.description: For maculopapular rash: over 30% body-surface area with moderate/severe symptoms, or limitation of self-care activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 4 — Grade 4
options.description: Grade 4 is not defined for uncomplicated maculopapular rash; use the appropriate severe cutaneous-reaction term if life-threatening features are present.

skin_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Identify the exact adverse event, assess symptoms and functional impact, and apply the toxicity-specific CTCAE v5.0 definition. Do not grade solely from a generic severity impression.

stomatitis_grade.label: Stomatitis / oral mucositis grade

options.label: Grade 1 — Grade 1
options.description: Asymptomatic or mild symptoms; intervention not indicated.

options.label: Grade 2 — Grade 2
options.description: Moderate pain or ulceration that does not interfere with oral intake; modified diet indicated.

options.label: Grade 3 — Grade 3
options.description: Severe pain that interferes with oral intake.

stomatitis_grade.assessment_guidance: Identify the exact adverse event, assess symptoms and functional impact, and apply the toxicity-specific CTCAE v5.0 definition. Do not grade solely from a generic severity impression.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Docetaxel is low emetogenic risk; the regimen also requires its protocol-specific corticosteroid premedication.
supportive_care.premedications: Docetaxel dexamethasone schedule exactly as stated in the NCCP source; if missed, follow the NCCP/local rescue pathway.
supportive_care.growth_factor: G-CSF may be used according to patient/regimen risk and NCCP guidance.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for low emetogenic risk

indications.description: First-line high-risk non-metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer.
Advanced or metastatic gastric or gastro-oesophageal junction adenocarcinoma after platinum-fluoropyrimidine treatment.
Locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC after failure of prior chemotherapy.
Relapsed or progressing ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal carcinoma.
Advanced prostate cancer treated with docetaxel 75 mg/m² every 21 days.
